# Annotation script attachment references

`generate_annotation_attachment.cjs` executes the unmodified, hash-pinned D2 MathJax 3.2.2 bundle for all 48 original D053 inputs. Each case binds the complete SVG bytes/dimensions and the complete explicit kind/text/attribute/child tree. `generate_script_attachment.cjs` separately calls the actual primary Subscript/Superscript methods for 120 family, occupied-slot, movesupsub and subsupOK combinations. It records selection/reuse and child ownership, then fills the chosen slot through the primary NodeUtil.setChild; compact output kinds only bridge Go's already accepted eager representation.

The reference baseline is accepted D056 merge `97eebae061dc96a046462472574ef2d6d4772078`. Fourteen annotation cases fail raw whole-SVG comparison on that parent and become exact with D053. All fourteen required error SVGs remain exact. Forty cases now match raw primary SVGs; eight pending-prime/superscript cases remain the separate D060 boundary, with their exact parent SVG and complete explicit tree retained. The additional eight tree-only receipts preserve four prime variantForm and four brace accent/accentunder distinctions already present on that parent; their SVGs are raw primary. These are explicit per-case receipts, not ignored fields or normalized comparisons. No new prime or brace behavior is claimed.

The source-shaped attachment helper checks family/subtype and occupied slots before choosing reuse or wrapping. An authored mover stays intact under an outside script; an authored munder with an occupied under slot still rejects a subscript. D056's transient `true` marker identifies eager generic script families. Its distinct pending-prime marker keeps the accepted fresh-wrapper consumption and Limits lifetime behavior; final compilation removes all such markers. The source method ownership fixture covers retained wrapper attributes/properties and exact child identities. The source handler does not rewrite authored annotations, disable duplicate-script errors, or change attachPrimes, explicit Limits, stackrel, or SVG rendering.

The two D050 subsequent-script qualifications are removed because this fix now makes those complete primary SVG/tree cases exact. The final candidate is based on accepted D054 merge `33983b0fb1d9f4e2a4d940e8f4d45a709d02012a`, whose separate stackrel correction removes the other two historical D050 qualifications. All 50 coupled stack-placement references therefore require raw primary SVG/tree equality. The 48 annotation baseline outputs and D060 receipts remain byte-identical across these two accepted parents. No dimension edits or paint tolerances are used.
